final: WITH state_totals AS (SELECT c.state_county_province AS state, COALESCE(SUM(ft.transaction_amount), 0) AS transaction_total FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.account_id = ft.account_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), state_shares AS (SELECT transaction_total, 1.0 * transaction_total / SUM(transaction_total) OVER () AS share FROM state_totals), compared AS (SELECT transaction_total, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM state_shares) SELECT SUM(transaction_total) AS combined_transaction_total, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess FROM compared WHERE share > average_share
